question: All 24 cores: cells per second for the backwards state() against a forward sweep?
apparatus: node worker threads, both methods, same circuit
refuted_if: (two numbers; refuted if they disagree on any state)
did: Ran the four bit adder (69 cells) for all 256 input pairs and 41 ticks, both ways, and compared every cell at every tick.
observed: 724,224 states compared, 0 differ; forwards 41,914,507 states a second, backwards with its cache 8,002,687 a second, one core
shows: The two ways are the same machine. Forwards is the one a graphics card can do (every cell at once from the last frame); backwards is the one that needs nothing held. Either may be used and checked against the other.
